[SWS_CM_10261] Serialization of an associative map
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00201, RS_CM_00202, RS_CM_00211
⌈
As far as serialization is concerned the serialized representation of an associative
map shall consist of the following parts without any intermediate padding:
•
Length field:
A length field describing the size of the associative map excluding
the length field itself in units of bytes.
•
Elements:
The individual map elements themselves
⌋
